title: Leverage: Redemption
description:

An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

title: The Messenger
description:
S01 E02
Ed must confront just how far he'll go to complete the card and comes to realize the messages may be coming from someone very close.

description:

description:

While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

description:

description:
S04 E10 — And Some Dude Named Jeff
After switching bodies with a 28-year-old slacker named Jeff, Jenkins enlists the help of Jeff's hapless friends to find his way back into the Library to correct the mistake.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E11 — And the Trial of the One
It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E12 — And the Echoes of Memory
The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E01 — And the Crown of King Arthur
Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E02 — And the Sword in the Stone
The Serpent Brotherhood is trying to return magic to the world; Flynn, Colonel Baird, and the potential Librarians must stop them before it's too late.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E03 — And the Horns of a Dilemma
The librarians' first solo mission hits a snag when Baird loses the others in a mysterious labyrinth that magically exists below the skyscraper of a modern corporation.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E04 — And Santa's Midnight Run
When the Serpent Brotherhood wants to kill Santa, the librarians must rescue him and help him accomplish the secret purpose of Christmas.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E05 — And the Apple of Discord
When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure.

description:

The team tries to get a violent hedge fund manager to reveal information that could lead to Damien Moreau.

description:

The team takes over a mall on Christmas Eve and uncovers a scheme perpetrated by an old nemesis; Eliot goes undercover as Santa Claus; Parker and Hardison are Santa's helpers.

description:
S03 E15 — The Big Bang Job
The team infiltrates a government research lab to stop Damien Moreau from auctioning information to international terrorists.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E16 — The San Lorenzo Job
After following Moreau to San Lorenzo, the team discovers that he is the chief advisor to the current President.

description:

The team must recover lost evidence from a mountain while battling hired guns and bad weather.

description:

When a mark is killed during a sting, the team races to complete the con and find the killer.

description:

The team attempts to take down a corrupt PR consultant by using his own methods against him.

title: Leverage
description:

While tracking a Van Gogh painting, the team learns the painting was the center of a World War II love story.

description:

description:

description:

The crew sets its sites on a funeral director who embezzles money from grieving patrons.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E08 — The Boiler Room Job
The team goes up against a con man from a long lineage of greats.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E09 — The Cross My Heart Job
The team tries to retrieve a stolen heart intended for a 15-year-old patient.
